name: @avatark/certification-authority
description: PLT-ADR-015: the narrative Certification Authority -- sole issuer of immutable, Ed25519-attested Certification Records for Interpretation and Episode certification. Wraps the existing pure evaluators unmodified; checks an administrator-issued per-subject-kind invocation grant; persists every issued record and every refused invocation through durable ports. Never publishes, promotes or mutates World state.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
